review_scope: Supplied parent archive convictions retained. Every listed stranded member and Grype assessed independently.
changes: 17 neutral observations relocated or consolidated; product-identity consumers corrected; sensitive dual-use observations retained.
coverage_gap: The supplied convicted containers emit no hostile/suspicious findings in this scan. Their fixed verdicts do not justify inventing attack traits for benign members. Current classifier disagreements with those convictions are reported separately.
regression_result: 12 controls passed; Git authorization-confusion, WHOIS dead-drop and Unicode-loader hostile detections retained; credential-read coverage restored under a generic rules directory.
classifier_disagreement: Both supplied-convicted containers remain ML class 0 before and after; probability 0.18086302 for the Go rootfs archive and 0.8856372 for the Vercel source archive. Labels are retained as instructed.
model_compatibility_note: Atomscan v2.13.0 / model v18.18 emitted an older feature-spec compatibility warning (18 versus extractor 19). Scores were treated only as leads.

grype_rescan_limitation.comparison_note: Native bin/grype has disassembly-incomplete and rizin_incomplete=1.
